item.title: IDF srikes Hezbollah missile production site
item.description:
A short while ago, the Israeli Air Force conducted a strike, guided by precise intelligence, in the Janta area in the Beqaa region of Lebanon, targeting a site that was previously used by the Hezbollah terrorist organization for missile production and the storage of weapons.
The site was struck by the IDF several times during the war. The IDF identified that Hezbollah terrorists had arrived at the site recently and struck the site's entrances in order to prevent its restoration.

item.title: Netanyahu for president, Eisenkot for PM? New plan explored in unity talks
item.description: Netanyahu associates and opposition figures are exploring a unity government plan: Netanyahu would serve first as PM in a rotation, then step aside to run for president. Moving up the presidential election through legislation is being considered.
